title: Genealogy Export Freshness Watch
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:ops source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures export lag by data source for genealogy data feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside genealogy data feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `export lag` on `genealogy:ops` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how long things take for each data source so you can see where genealogy data feeds slows down.
